model_info_before_query.provider: OpenAI (Query Tools) / Groq (Other Endpoints) / Nomic Atlas (Embeddings)

tools.name: Vidu Studio Flux AI Image Gen
tools.description: Vidu Studio uses the Flux.1 models to turn any textual prompt into high‑resolution images, letting creators generate photorealistic or stylized visuals directly from words.
bullets: Supports multiple Flux.1 variants for varied artistic styles
Generates up to 4 MP images with custom aspect ratios for versatile use

tools.name: Diffusion Bee
tools.description: Diffusion Bee runs Stable Diffusion locally on macOS, enabling offline text‑to‑image generation without any cloud service, perfect for privacy‑focused creators.
bullets: Full offline operation preserves prompt and output privacy
Includes text‑to‑image, image‑to‑image and upscaling in one Mac‑native app

tools.name: Craiyon
tools.description: Craiyon offers a free web interface that quickly converts short text prompts into a set of nine AI‑generated images, ideal for casual experimentation.
bullets: Unlimited free usage without registration
Provides quick, nine‑image grids for rapid idea exploration

tools.name: Pixa
tools.description: Pixa delivers instant, free text‑to‑image generation with a minimalist UI, letting users type a description and receive high‑quality outputs in seconds.
bullets: No sign‑up or paywall – generate images instantly
Multiple resolution options to fit social, web, or print needs

tools.name: FLUX AI
tools.description: FLUX AI leverages a cutting‑edge 4o image generator to produce detailed visuals from text, with special support for embedding accurate typography within the artwork.
bullets: Creates images with integrated, stylized text for branding or graphics
Offers both text‑to‑image and image‑to‑image workflows for refinement

tools.name: Image-Ai
tools.description: Image‑AI.pro provides a browser‑based, GPT‑4o‑enhanced text‑to‑image engine that yields studio‑quality pictures while offering granular style and lighting controls.
bullets: Granular controls for style, lighting, composition, and color via intuitive sliders
VIP option unlocks faster generation and higher‑resolution exports

tools.name: OmniGen
tools.description: OmniGen unifies text‑to‑image generation, editing, and conditional visual tasks in a single model, allowing creators to generate and refine images without switching tools.
bullets: Supports direct text prompts and reference images for iterative editing
API access enables integration of text‑to‑image capabilities into external apps

tools.name: Imagen 3
tools.description: Imagen 3 from Google DeepMind translates natural‑language prompts into photorealistic or stylized images with exceptional detail and accurate text rendering.
bullets: High‑fidelity photorealism with advanced lighting and texture handling
Built‑in inpainting/outpainting tools for selective image edits

tools.name: Ideogram
tools.description: Ideogram specializes in generating images that include precise, aesthetically pleasing typography, making it ideal for marketing graphics and social media posts created from text prompts.
bullets: Accurate text embedding with customizable fonts and styles
Simple prompt‑only interface removes the need for design expertise

tools.name: Bing Image Creator
tools.description: Bing Image Creator uses GPT‑4o and DALL·E 3 to instantly turn user‑provided text into diverse images, accessible directly via Bing or Microsoft Edge.
bullets: Free, web‑based generation with instant results across devices
Leverages powerful GPT‑4o/DALL·E 3 models for both photorealistic and artistic outputs

tools.name: PromptImage
tools.description: PromptImage is an AI-powered tool that enables users to create stunning images simply by providing text descriptions. It aims to overcome common hurdles in visual content creation, such as the time-consuming nature of traditional editing, the high costs of professional design software or stock photos, and the necessity of artistic skill.
bullets: Ease of Use: The simple text-to-image prompt makes it accessible to anyone
regardless of design experience.

tools.name: CGDream
tools.description: CGDream is an AI-powered image generator and creative toolkit that allows users to create, edit, and customize stunning visuals using text, existing images, or 3D models. With features like text-to-image, image-to-image, AI photo editing, 3D rendering, upscaling, inpainting, and 300+ unique filters and styles, CGDream empowers everyone from beginners to professionals to generate original art, commercial visuals, or digital collectibles—all in one intuitive online platform.
bullets: Category: AI Photo & Image Generator
Feature available

tools.name: Gemini 2.0 Flash Preview Image
tools.description: Gemini 2.0 Flash Preview Image Generation is Google’s experimental vision feature built into the Flash model. It enables developers to generate and edit images alongside text in a conversational manner and supports multi-turn, context-aware visual workflows via the Gemini API or Vertex AI.
bullets: Category: Text to Image
Feature available

tools.name: GenColor AI
tools.description: GenColor.ai is a free, web-based AI tool that converts your photos or text prompts into clean, printable coloring pages. Designed for art enthusiasts of all ages, it supports both photo-to-line-art conversions and imaginative scene generation from text—all without requiring signup or payment.
bullets: Instant Creativity: Upload or describe
and AI delivers results in seconds.

tools.name: StoryArtAI
tools.description: StoryArt.ai is an AI-powered tool specifically designed to help users create unique and stunning illustrations, primarily for children's books. Its main purpose is to bring stories to life by generating custom illustrations from simple text prompts, allowing imaginations to soar without the need for traditional drawing skills.
bullets: Specifically tailored for children's book illustrations.
Offers a wide and appealing range of illustration styles.

tools.name: Image Pig
tools.description:
ImagePig is a REST API that provides fast, affordable AI-powered image generation and editing tools. It supports tasks such as photo creation from text prompts, background removal, upscaling, face swapping, and outpainting. 
Designed for developers and content teams, ImagePig delivers API-based image generation across 30+ languages and includes SDKs in Python, Node.js, Rust, and more. Its simple pricing and flexible integration make it ideal for embedding AI imaging capabilities into apps or pipelines.
bullets: Developer-focused API simplifies integration.
Diverse capabilities—generation

tools.name: Style Art AI
tools.description:
Style Art AI is an advanced AI image generation platform that allows users to transform text or photos into artworks across more than 30 artistic styles, including anime, cartoons, Disney‑inspired imagery, and more. It uses the cutting‑edge ChatGPT 4o visual model to create detailed, style‑rich images from simple prompts or uploaded images. Whether you're converting wedding photos into Disney‑style animations, enhancing travel snapshots into stylish magazine covers, or generating new artwork from scratch.
 Style Art AI makes it easy to produce creative visuals—even without artistic expertise. The platform supports both text‑to‑image and image‑to‑image transformation, enabling a broad range of customization and creative expression. Credit usage is flexible, with free daily credits available and paid plans offering increased quotas and enhanced capabilities.
bullets: Extensive style options enable dynamic creativity
Both text‑to‑image and image‑to‑image workflows supported

tools.name: grok-2-vision-latest
tools.description: Grok 2 Vision is xAI’s advanced vision-enabled variant of Grok 2, launched in December 2024. It supports joint text + image inputs with a 32K-token context window, combining image understanding, document QA, visual math reasoning (e.g., MathVista, DocVQA), and photorealistic image generation via FLUX.1 (later complemented by Aurora). It scores state-of-the-art on multimodal tasks.
bullets: State-of-the-art visual math and document Q&A performance
Combines image analysis and generation via FLUX.1

tools.name: grok-2-vision-1212
tools.description: Grok 2 Vision – 1212 is a December 2024 release of xAI’s multimodal large language model, fine-tuned specifically for image understanding and generation. It supports combined text and image inputs (up to 32,768 tokens) and excels in document question answering, visual math reasoning, object recognition, and photorealistic image generation powered by FLUX.1. It also supports API deployment for developers and enterprises.
bullets: Strong performance in visual math and document-based QA
Combines image input + generation in a single call

tools.name: grok-2-image
tools.description: Grok 2 Image is xAI’s image-generation model integrated into the Grok 2 family, first added in August 2024. Initially powered by FLUX.1 developed by Black Forest Labs, it later shifted to xAI's own Aurora model in December 2024. It supports multimodal input—allowing users to generate, edit, and chat using images—with a 32K-token visual-text context and produces photorealistic outputs.
bullets: Generates high-quality
realistic images promptly

tools.name: grok-2-vision
tools.description: Grok 2 Vision (also known as Grok‑2‑Vision‑1212 or grok‑2‑vision‑latest) is xAI’s multimodal variant of Grok 2, designed specifically for advanced image understanding and generation. Launched in December 2024, it supports joint text+image inputs up to 32,768 tokens, excelling in visual math reasoning (MathVista), document question answering (DocVQA), object recognition, and style analysis—while also offering photorealistic image creation via the FLUX.1 model.
bullets: Excellent at visual math and doc QA tasks
Integrated photorealistic image generation via FLUX.1

tools.name: Mistral Pixtral Large
tools.description: Pixtral Large is Mistral AI’s latest multimodal powerhouse, launched November 18, 2024. Built atop the 123B‑parameter Mistral Large 2, it features a 124B‑parameter multimodal decoder paired with a 1B‑parameter vision encoder, and supports a massive 128K‑token context window—enabling it to process up to 30 high-resolution images or ~300-page documents.
bullets: SOTA performance across multimodal vision benchmarks
Massive 128K-token capacity for expansive context

tools.name: grok-2-image-1212
tools.description: Grok 2 Image 1212 (also known as grok-2-image-1212) is xAI’s December 2024 release of their unified image generation and understanding model. Built on Grok 2, it combines Aurora-powered photorealistic image creation with strong multimodal comprehension—handling image editing, vision QA, chart interpretation, and document analysis—within a single API and 32,768-token context.
bullets: All-in-one vision model for generation and understanding
Photorealism with Aurora and editing capabilities

tools.name: grok-2-image-latest
tools.description: Grok 2 Image (a.k.a. Grok 2‑image‑latest) is xAI’s vision-forward extension of its Grok 2 model. Released in December 2024, it merges photorealistic image generation via Aurora with strong image understanding capabilities—supporting object detection, chart analysis, OCR, and visual reasoning tasks. Operates in a unified multimodal pipeline using text+image inputs up to 32K-token context.
bullets: Fusion of visual reasoning and generation in one model
Powerful photorealistic Aurora engine

tools.name: Illustration Generator
tools.description: Icon 8 Illustration Generator is an AI-powered art maker that creates series of consistent, high-quality illustrations and vector icons in professional art styles crafted by Icons8’s in-house artists. It’s ideal for designers, marketers, and creators who need cohesive visuals without legal concerns.
bullets: Structurally consistent art across multiple images for coherent visual experiences.
Fully licensed commercial use eliminates legal risk.

tools.name: IllustraAI
tools.description: illustration.app (also referred to as Illustra AI based on the URL) is an AI-powered vector illustration generator that allows users to create custom, scalable vector illustrations quickly and easily using simple text prompts. It aims to solve the challenges of generic stock images and expensive custom illustrations by providing a cost-effective and efficient solution for generating unique visuals.
bullets: Fast & Easy Creation: Generates unique illustrations quickly from text prompts
saving significant time.

tools.description: Rast.AI is an innovative AI-powered graphic design platform that offers easy-to-use AI Logo Maker and AI Poster Maker apps, empowering users to create stunning visual designs effortlessly. Extensive Customization Options: Full control over design elements ensures unique outputs.
